text:
carmen: Auditor Emma asked for evidence that CVE-2027-0001 was triaged and the RBAC change deployed, plus KMS activity for secret rotation. Wants chain: vuln report -> ticket -> PR -> CI artifact -> deploy -> audit logs -> KMS. Sampling OK.
phil: We have ticket SEC-900, PR https://github.com/redwood/security/pull/6001 (branch: rbac/patch-900) and deploy tag release-2027.03.10. Deployed 2027-03-10T09:17Z.
yusuf: Quick question: do they need raw IPs or can we HMAC them?
auditor_emma: HMAC/pseudonymization is fine. Provide algorithm, per-bundle salt storage path, and a signed attestation. One PDF per mapped control (SOC2/ISO). I'll request an unredacted single-line sample under NDA if needed.
carmen: Plan: produce manifest, control-crosswalk.pdf, pr-and-ci.pdf, logs-redacted.tar.gz, kms-hmac.csv, attestation-signed.pdf. We'll sign the bundle and include timestamp from TSA.
phil: Extraction notes: k8s audit slice command I used:
```
kubectl logs -n kube-system audit-collector --since=96h | jq 'select(.objectRef.name=="authz-service")' > /tmp/authz-audit.json
```
Returned ~2.9k events.
yusuf: KMS logs in BigQuery table prod.kms_audit. Example query I ran:
```
SELECT timestamp, protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, protoPayload.methodName, resourceName
FROM `prod.kms_audit`
WHERE protoPayload.methodName IN ("Encrypt","Decrypt","UpdateCryptoKeyVersion")
  AND timestamp BETWEEN TIMESTAMP("2027-03-01") AND TIMESTAMP("2027-03-12")
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 2000;
```
We will HMAC principalEmail/ip with HMAC-SHA256(email||bundle_salt).
carmen: Security: confirm HMAC approach and salt storage?
security-team: Approved. Store bundle_salt at internal-keystore/evidence/1810007777. Do NOT include mapping in bundle. Document algorithm and key access policy in manifest.
auditor_emma: Also include cosign signature for CI artifact if available, and a timestamp proof (TSA) — we need non-repudiation for the artifact chain.
phil: CI artifact recorded: artifact-registry://redwood/builds/6001@sha256:f9d4... cosign verify output will be attached and Rekor entry: https://rekor.sigstore.dev/entries/abc12345
yusuf: Redaction example (bash):
```
sed -E 's/\"principalEmail\":\s*\"[^\"]+\"/\"principalEmail\":\"HMAC_REDACTED\"/g' authz-audit.json > authz-audit-redacted.json
```
Then post-process to insert HMAC values using bundle_salt.
carmen: evidence packaging plan: manifest.txt (index + algorithms + TSA URL + Rekor URL + sha256 bundle hash), control-crosswalk.pdf (maps files to SOC2:CC6/CC7 and ISO:A.9/A.12), pr-and-ci.pdf (screenshots allowed), logs-redacted.tar.gz, kms-hmac.csv, attestation-signed.pdf. Host at gs://redwood-compliance/evidence/SEC-900/1810007777/.
evidence-bot: packaging job started: sec-900-evidence-1810007777.zip (assembling 6 artifacts). ETA ~2m.
phil: One security ask: include KMS key metadata (HSM-backed) and key version IDs used during the deploy window. We'll attach a short signed KMS attestation.
security-team: Added KMS attestation note and signed statement from CISO: keys are HSM-backed and rotation schedule enforced. Include signed statement in bundle.
auditor_emma: Good. I may request one unredacted sample line under NDA, please include escalation contact and NDA process in README. Also ensure the manifest contains the TSA timestamp URL for the bundle signature.
carmen: Upload complete: gs://redwood-compliance/evidence/SEC-900/sec-900-evidence-1810007777.zip (5.0MB). sha256: e2b7f2a5... Manifest contains Rekor + TSA links.
yusuf: Ticket updated: SEC-900-EVID. I'll follow up with the CSV and confirmation of HMAC salt storage.
auditor_emma: I'll validate and ACK or request an NDA sample later today. Thanks everyone.
carmen: Closing loop after auditor ACKs.
security-team: Note: originals retained per retention policy, access via compliance workflow under NDA. Documented in README.
